title: the dancer jumps to the centre and dances the clap
story: Melody, El Baile del Gorila, 123 bpm kids pop with four-on-the-floor. Four bars of a quiet room (rms 0.05): the body wanders off-centre, its gaze sweeps slowly and it blinks on every off-beat hat. The drop at 445 (kick, 11.29) jumps it to the centre and bounces it, and the peak at 466 (16.10) flashes and shakes it. After that every beat bounces the body, every clap (beats 2 and 4) teleports it to the next corner in a dance step, the hats blink, and the colour sways a little each bar. The prominent claps 742 and 836 get a shake and a zoom.
